RC SERIES CIRCUIT TROUBLESHOOTING PRACTICE I
OBJECTIVES
1. RC Series Circuit Troubleshooting Practice I
w Identify an open component in an RC series circuit.
w Identify a shorted component in an RC series circuit.
w Identify a changed value component in an RC series
. The experiment in this lesson is not setup to use the selected trainer.
EQUIPMENT REQUIRED
Nida Experiment Card PC130 - 14A
In this lesson you will calculate voltage drops in a RC series circuit.

text: The following experiments reinforce procedures used to troubleshoot RC series circuits. You will compare calculated values with measured circuit values to determine if a fault exists.s.

1. Set the Test Console controls to the initial control settings..........
2. Carefully plug PC130-14A into the Test Console PC1 position. to ON.
